text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}とヒヨリは食べ歩きを終えると、
腹ごなしも兼ねて一緒に初売りへと出かけた。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Do you mind if we check out that store, Mr. Knight?
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士くん、
あのお店行ってもいいかな？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: There's something I really, [i]really[/i] wanna get there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしね、
どうしてもゲットしたいものがあるんだ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: This should be the place.
text_block_list.orig_text: このお店で売ってるんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Beloved customers! Landosol's largest store is back at it again! We've
prepared a grab bag with a luxurious prize, and you better believe it'll
put us in the red! But who has the mettle to win?! Come test your luck!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ご来店の皆さま！　
ランドソル最大の商店である私たちが、
今年も赤字覚悟で、
最高の福袋をご用意させていただきました！
一体今年は誰が最高の福を引き当てるのか！　
どうぞ挑戦を！

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
The wheel of fortune is yours to spin! But only the blessed will win!
What will be your fate? The audience can't wait!
So come one, come all! Show us your potential!
text_block_list.orig_text:
回るよ回るあなたの幸運！　
引き当てたならまさに豪運！
見せつけましょうあなたの天分！　
気になる人は逃すな見聞！
さあさあ、
あなたもハンドルを回してみませんか〜？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Did you hear that? They only do this once a year,
but you get a [i]super[/i] expensive prize for cheap if you win!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今の聞こえた？　
すっごく高い商品をたくさん詰めた特別な福袋が、
毎年一つだけ、
とっても安いお値段で売られるんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
And just like they said, it's all down to luck!
You need to spin and win to get the right to buy it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかもね、
お店の前でやってるくじを引いて、
当たりを出した人しか買えないんだ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
I keep hearing about how low the odds are,
so I've always been curious about giving it a shot. ♪
choice_data_list: I want to try it as well.
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんながよく当たんないって言ってたし、
一度挑戦してみたかったんだよねー♪

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Really?
Then let's see if we've got any New Year's luck together. Time to spin!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ホントに？
じゃあ新年の運試し、
一緒にやっちゃおー！

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, welcome! Please step in line!
Who knows? You might just have a lucky spot!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ようこそお客様！　
列にお並びください！
その順番すらも
あなたの運のよさかも知れませんよ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Hopefully that's the case!
I'm so excited!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ、
そうだといいなー！
わくわく！　
わくわく！

text_block_list.name: Man 1
text_block_list.text: Haaah! Gimme the goods, baby!
text_block_list.orig_text:
とりゃー！　
当たれー！

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, my friend.
You do get complimentary tissues, though.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……はい、
はずれです。
こちら、
参加賞のちり紙です。

text_block_list.name: Man 1
text_block_list.text:
Dammit.
Next year for sure!
text_block_list.orig_text:
くっそぉ……
来年は当ててやる！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: I kind of expected it, but the odds really are low.
text_block_list.orig_text:
分かってたけど、
誰も当たりが引けないよ……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
But also, that's a good thing for us!
I can't let the odds get to me, either. I'm in it to win it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやいや、
当たってなくてラッキーなんだ！
それに
あたしが絶対当たりを引く、
くらいに思ってなきゃだよね！

text_block_list.name: Man 2
text_block_list.text: My turn! Let's gooo!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今度は俺の番だ！　
いっけぇ～！

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: Aaand nope!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい
はずれー！

text_block_list.name: Man 3
text_block_list.text: Come on! Get in there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
とりゃー！　
当たれー！

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: Not this time!
text_block_list.orig_text: はずれー！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Urgh... I'm losing all confidence here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ううう……
だんだん当たらない気がしてきた。

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
It's your turn, young lady!
Show us what you've got! Give it a good spin!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お客様！　
お客様の番ですよ！
ささっ！　
ガラっと回して当たりを引き当てましょう！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
...Okay!
Power me up, Mr. Knight!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
はいっ！
騎士くん！　
強化して！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Thanks! Feels like my luck's through the roof now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがと！　
なんかツキも強化された気がする！

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: Wow! This might just be it, folks!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おお……！　
これは……！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna win! For sure!
text_block_list.orig_text:
必ず、
引いてみせる……！！

text_block_list.name: Man 1
text_block_list.text: She's popping off!
text_block_list.orig_text: すごい気合だ……！

text_block_list.name: Man 2
text_block_list.text: Sure is! This might just be the one!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
コイツぁ
ひょっとすると決まりかもな……！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Come on! Let's goooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……一等、
当たれぇぇぇーっ！

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: Ohhhhhh! C-could it be?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おおおおおっ！？　
こ、
これはー！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Ahh... Ahhhhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ……
ああーーーっ！

text_block_list.name: Man 1
text_block_list.text: Did she do it?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まさか、
来たのか！？

text_block_list.name: Man 2
text_block_list.text: Do we finally have a winner?!
text_block_list.orig_text: ついに当選者が……！？

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Close, but no cigar!
Here's your tissues!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はずれー！　
参加賞でーす！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... So much for that.
Sorry, Mr. Knight. I made your power-up go to waste...
choice_data_list: It's too early to give in.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ううぅー、
だめだったー……
ごめんね騎士くーん……
せっかく強化してくれたのにー……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... You're right.
It'll be back next year, so I'll definitely win then! For sure!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん……
そうだね、
これが最後じゃないもんね。
来年は当てるよ！　
きっと！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: But next up is your turn!
text_block_list.orig_text: 次は騎士くんの番だよ！

text_block_list.name: Man 2
text_block_list.text:
He's got a lot less vigor than her.
Think he'll manage it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっきの女の子に比べると覇気がないな。
大丈夫か……？

text_block_list.name: Man 1
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't seem like he's even interested.
I bet he just lined up for the hell of it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
当てようって気がないんじゃないか？
見物ついでに並んでみたんだろ。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Mr. Knight! Spin it real good!
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士くーん！　
ガラッと回しちゃえー！

text_block_list.name: Man 3
text_block_list.text: Oh. There it is.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
出てきた。

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Oh... 
Oh my gosh, folks! The mad lad did it!
Here's your coupon for the prize!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お……
大当たり～！　
こちら、
当選商品引換券です！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
What?! For real?! That's amazing!
You did it, Mr. Knight! You won!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えええーっ！？　
すごいすごーい！
やったー！　
やったね騎士くん！　
当たりだよ！

text_block_list.name: Man 1
text_block_list.text: Well that was a bit of a letdown.
text_block_list.orig_text: なーんかあっさり決まっちまったな。

text_block_list.name: Man 2
text_block_list.text: I figured someone with a bit more zest would've pulled it off.
text_block_list.orig_text: もっと気合いの入ったヤツが当てるもんかと思ってたけど……

text_block_list.name: Man 3
text_block_list.text:
Nah, man.
This is the power of a calm, pure mind.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやいや、
コイツは無欲の勝利ってヤツさ。

text_block_list.name: Man 1
text_block_list.text:
Fair enough.
It probably takes a will of steel to stay composed
knowing you might just get a super luxurious prize.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なるほど、
確かに。
この場で欲望をむき出しにするより、
平常心でいるほうが
難しいかも知れないな。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Yup! He was the same as ever!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだよ！　
いつも通りだった。

text_block_list.name: Man 2
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for saying all that, man.
If anyone deserved to win, it was you! Congrats!
text_block_list.orig_text:
勝手なこと言って悪かったよ。
アンタは当選者にふさわしい人だ！　
おめでとう！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations!
Come on, let's go exchange that coupon for the grab bag!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おめでとう騎士くん！
さぁ、
その引換券で福袋を買おうよ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's wrong?
choice_data_list: I... don't have enough for it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん……？　
どうしたの騎士くん？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Huh?!
text_block_list.orig_text: えええーっ！？

text_block_list.name: Participants
text_block_list.text: You WHAT?!
text_block_list.orig_text: はあああーっ！？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
We worked together on New Year's Eve, right?
What happened to the money from that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士くん、
大晦日のお仕事でもらったお金はどうしたの？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
You gave most of it to Kokkoro, huh?
And then you spent the rest on the food we ate earlier...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あのお金、
ほとんどコッコロちゃんにあげちゃったんだ。
それに残りはさっき食べ歩きの時に、
ほとんど使っちゃったんだね……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
How much? More than half of it?
Wait. Almost [i]all[/i] of it?
So what you spent today was pretty much all that was left...
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしかして、
半分以上？　
え、
ほとんど全部？
じゃあご飯代くらいしか持ってなかったんだ……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Well... That's a good thing, at least.
You got to repay her for everything she's done for you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっか……
騎士くん、
よかったね。
お世話になったお礼がちゃんとできたんだもん。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Mr. Knight. I'll cover for what you don't have, so go buy it.
The fact that we came together can be seen as good fortune, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士くん。
足りない分はあたしが貸すから、
買ってきて。
あたしが一緒だったのも、
きっと騎士くんの幸運だから。
ね？

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
{0} accepts Hiyori's money and enters the store,
returning with the grab bag not long after.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒヨリにお金を借りた{0}は店に入り、
しばらくして福袋を持って出てきた。

text_block_list.name: Participants
text_block_list.text: Congratulations!
text_block_list.orig_text: おめでとうー！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Look, look! Everyone's celebrating!
Man, that must feel nice. I gotta try harder next year.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほらほら、
みんな騎士くんをお祝いしてるよ！
いいなぁー……
あたしも来年がんばろうっと！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What're you doing?
Wait. Y-you're giving it to me? But why?
choice_data_list: As thanks for lending me the money.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ？　
騎士くん……？
これ、
あ、
あたしにくれるの！？　
なんで？　
どうして……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
You're the one that won it, though.
That, plus I...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
これは騎士くんが当てたんだよ？
それならあたしは……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: ...Were you planning on giving it to me from the very start?
choice_data_list: Good fortune, from me to you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
もしかして、
最初からあたしに渡すつもりだった……？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
...!
Mr. Knight!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……！　
騎士くーん！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Thanks so much! I love you! For real!
There's no one luckier than me today!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとう騎士くん！　
大好きっ！　
ホントにありがとー！
今日のあたし、
すっごくラッキーだった！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Don't ever leave me, okay?
Promise! Ehehe!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これからも一緒だよ！　
約束だからねっ！　
えへへっ！

text_block_list.name: Man 1
text_block_list.text: Damn. He was gonna give it to his girlfriend all along, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだ、
あの福袋を彼女にあげるためだったのか……

text_block_list.name: Man 2
text_block_list.text:
Talk about the power of love.
Way to show off, buddy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
愛で運を引き寄せたってわけか。
見せつけてくれるぜ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.orig_text: へっ……？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Oh!
No! You've got it all wrong!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ……！
ちがっ！　
違うんです！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
I'm not his girlfriend! Really!
There's nothing like that between us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたし、
彼女じゃないんです！
騎士くんとはそういうのじゃなくて……！

text_block_list.name: Man 2
text_block_list.text:
Yeah yeah, we hear you.
Treat that cutie right, brother!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああはいはい、
いいからいいから。
かわいい彼女を大事にしろよー！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: I swear! It's not like that!
text_block_list.orig_text: だから違うんだってばー！

text_block_list.name: Man 1
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, we get it.
Thanks for kicking off the new year with some good memories!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいのいいの、
みんな分かってるからさ。
正月早々いいもん見せてくれて
ありがとな！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
You don't get it!
You don't get it at all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だーかーらー！　
ホントに違うのー！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: I mean, he's already got Yui...
text_block_list.orig_text:
だって騎士くんには、
ユイちゃんがいるし……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Don't just stand there! Say something!
choice_data_list: Dunno what's going on, but it seems fine.
text_block_list.orig_text: 騎士くんもなんとか言ってよー！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
You as well?!
Come on! It's anything but fine!
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士くんまで！？
もー！　
全然
よくないんだってばー！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Some say that Hiyori's desperate attempts to explain the
situation still resound throughout Landosol to this day.
text_block_list.orig_text:
頬を染めながら誤解だと弁明するヒヨリの声が、
ランドソルの空に何度もこだましたのだった。
